text:
mike: Heads-up — customer reported a 400 from /rerank: `vector length mismatch`. Python quickstart works, JS sample app failing. Error: `expected 1024, got 1025`.
claire: Can you paste the request body (query + candidates) or at least the lengths? Is this definitely server-side /rerank?
mike: Server-side /rerank. Payload snippet (sanitized):
```
{
  "query_embedding": [0.12, 0.23, ..., 0.0],
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "embedding": [0.05, 0.11, ..., 0.0]},
    {"id": "c2", "embedding": [0.07, 0.09, ..., 0.0]}
  ]
}
```
Lengths printed: query=1024, c1=1025, c2=1025. Model: redwood/embed-1024.
jess: Repro'd locally. Our JS sample-app's batcher `packVectors()` mutates vectors and appends an index slot during local scoring, but the helper was never removing it for network requests. Oops.
```js
// sample-app/js/batcher.js
function packVectors(vecs){
  return vecs.map((v,i) => { v.push(i); return v; })
}
```
mike: That would explain python quickstart using an immutable pack helper (no mutation).
rajesh: Also noticed SDK parity: python SDK auto-retries 429/503 by default; JS SDK defaults to no retries unless opt-in. This customer retried client-side making rerank heavier and hitting rate limits. Two contributing issues.
claire: So action: (A) patch sample-app to stop appending extra slot and add pre-send validation, (B) align retry defaults across SDKs or at least document parity clearly.
jess: I'll open a PR to: remove the accidental push, add `validateVectorLength(vec, expected)` helper, and add a unit test for vector dims. Quick fix in sample-app: use `const safe = v.slice(0, expected)` before sending. Also add a `README.md` note.
mike: Can you give me a one-liner workaround to share with the customer now?
jess: One-liner: `const clean = emb => emb.length === expected ? emb : emb.slice(0, expected)` — run this over query + candidates before sending. I'll add it to the quickstart README.
rajesh: I'll file a cross-SDK ticket to standardize retry policy: exponential backoff with jitter, handle 429/503, max 6 retries, surface retry-after header. Will propose propagating to JS/Go/Python.
sam (deploy-bot): deploy:devex-samples - sample-app main -> staging queued, tests green.
claire: Also propose improving server-side error messaging: instead of `400: vector length mismatch`, include expected dims and hint about sample apps/quickstart. Eg: `400: vector length mismatch (expected 1024); if you used our sample apps, please upgrade to latest.` That'll reduce noisy tickets.
rajesh: Good idea — I'll draft the validation message change and review with infra/eng-runtime.
jess: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-samples/pull/512 — removes accidental metadata append, adds `validateVectorLength` helper, and unit tests. Will backport to templates.
mike: I'll send customer the workaround and keep this thread updated. Once PR merges, we change status to resolved.
claire: Tagging @devex for a short post-mortem doc and summarizing customer impact for support.
jess: Note: found two other repos where a similar `push(i)` pattern existed in starter code. I'll sweep and open follow-ups.
mike: Thanks all :thumbsup: Closing the onboarding ticket after customer confirmation.
